title: Hazel the Little Tractor and the Moonlight Harvest
description: A meadow-green tractor and a fluffy cream sheep gather pumpkins for a quiet Moonlight Harvest, share warm treats under the stars, and settle to sleep in the barn.

Hazel.role: Main character; a little farm tractor
Hazel.color: Meadow-green body with a pale cream grille, cream canopy, cream wheel rims, and warm-yellow headlights
Hazel.bodyShape: Small rounded tractor on four chunky black tires with larger rear wheels; no arms, hands, legs, clothing, or construction attachments
Hazel.face: Two large expressive brown eyes on the windshield and a small gentle smile on the grille
Hazel.accessories: Small cream canopy on thin green posts; no logos, stickers, numbers, or text

Clover.role: Supporting character; a fluffy farm sheep
Clover.color: Soft cream wool with a warm beige face and a tiny rosy-brown nose
Clover.bodyShape: Round compact sheep on four short beige legs with dark-brown hooves; about as tall as Hazel's front hood; no clothing
Clover.face: Large dark-brown eyes, tiny rosy-brown nose, and a soft smile

settingBible.Moonlight Meadow Farm: A peaceful farm with a cozy red barn, pumpkin patch, dirt path, wooden wagon, harvest table with lanterns, and soft rolling hills under moonlight
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded vehicles and animals, golden evening fading to moonlight, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Hazel stays meadow-green with a cream canopy, brown windshield eyes, cream wheel rims, and soft warm headlights.
Clover stays a smaller cream sheep with a beige face and first appears on page 5.
The wooden pumpkin wagon appears from page 5, carries pumpkins through page 8, then parks near the barn.
No rescue, repair, breakdown, danger, or frightening scenes.
Background farm animals stay simple and subordinate on the harvest pages.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: On a peaceful little farm, a friendly green tractor named Hazel rested beside a cozy red barn.
pages.illustrationScene: Meadow-green tractor Hazel rests beside a cozy red barn on a peaceful little farm.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Hazel: meadow green, cream canopy, brown windshield eyes, cream wheel rims, larger rear tires. Clover absent.

pages.text: As the sun slipped behind the hills, the farm glowed with warm golden evening light.
pages.illustrationScene: Warm golden evening light glows across the farm as the sun slips behind the hills.
pages.continuityNotes: Hazel alone in warm golden evening light near the farm.

pages.text: Tonight was the Moonlight Harvest, a gentle celebration beneath the twinkling stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Twilight settles over the farm as the Moonlight Harvest begins beneath the first stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Moonlight Harvest begins; Hazel alone under early stars.

pages.text: Hazel rolled slowly toward the pumpkin patch, where round orange pumpkins rested among leafy vines.
pages.illustrationScene: Hazel rolls slowly toward a pumpkin patch of round orange pumpkins among leafy vines.
pages.continuityNotes: Hazel alone rolling toward pumpkin patch; no wagon yet.

pages.text: Her friend Clover, a fluffy cream-colored sheep, waited beside a little wooden wagon.
pages.illustrationScene: Cream sheep Clover waits beside a little wooden wagon near Hazel at the pumpkin patch.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Clover: cream wool, beige face, smaller than Hazel; wooden wagon appears.

pages.text: “Let’s bring some pumpkins to the barn,” whispered Clover with a happy smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Clover smiles happily and invites Hazel to bring some pumpkins to the barn.
pages.continuityNotes: Clover invites Hazel to bring pumpkins; gentle, no urgency.

pages.text: Hazel carefully pulled the wagon while Clover walked beside her through the quiet fields.
pages.illustrationScene: Hazel carefully pulls the wagon of pumpkins while Clover walks beside her through quiet fields.
pages.continuityNotes: Hazel pulls wagon; Clover walks beside; quiet fields.

pages.text: Fireflies sparkled above the grass, lighting their path like tiny floating lanterns.
pages.illustrationScene: Fireflies sparkle above the grass, lighting Hazel and Clover's path like tiny lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Fireflies light the path; headlights may glow softly.

pages.text: At the barn, Hazel and Clover found a long wooden table, but it was only decorated with pumpkins and glowing lanterns.
pages.illustrationScene: At the red barn, Hazel and Clover arrive at a long wooden table with pumpkins and glowing lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Arrive at barn table with pumpkins and lanterns; wagon parked nearby.

pages.text: The farm animals gathered beneath the stars and shared sweet apple slices and warm pumpkin treats.
pages.illustrationScene: Friendly farm animals gather under the stars to share apple slices and warm pumpkin treats.
pages.continuityNotes: Background animals may appear subordinate; share treats calmly.

pages.text: A gentle breeze rustled the leaves as everyone listened to the soft chirping of crickets.
pages.illustrationScene: A gentle breeze rustles leaves while everyone listens to soft cricket chirps.

pages.text: Clover gave a sleepy yawn, and Hazel's little headlights glowed softly in the moonlight.
pages.illustrationScene: Clover yawns sleepily as Hazel's warm headlights glow softly in the moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Clover yawns; Hazel's headlights soft in moonlight.

pages.text: “What a lovely harvest night,” whispered Clover, resting beside a golden pile of hay.
pages.illustrationScene: Clover rests beside a golden pile of hay and whispers about the lovely harvest night.
pages.continuityNotes: Clover rests by hay; lovely harvest night.

pages.text: Hazel parked beneath the barn's wooden roof while Clover curled up in the warm, soft straw.
pages.illustrationScene: Hazel parks under the barn roof while Clover curls up in warm soft straw.
pages.continuityNotes: Hazel parked under barn roof; Clover in straw.

pages.text: And as the moon shone over the sleeping farm, Hazel and Clover dreamed of golden fields and gentle harvest nights.
pages.illustrationScene: Hazel and Clover sleep peacefully as the moon shines over the quiet farm.
pages.continuityNotes: Both asleep; moon over sleeping farm; peaceful ending.
